title: Two final questions contradict each other
rationale: Q-04 asks the same thing as Q-03 but its key gives the opposite answer. Each key reads plausibly on its own; together they contradict. Modelled on the real miss found in the Photosynthesis demo (two questions using 'primary electron donor' for different things), which neither QC layer caught.

mutations.value: A bank has past transactions, each marked 'fraud' or 'not fraud', and wants to flag new fraudulent transactions. Which type of learning fits, and why?
Unsupervised learning, because the model must discover the fraud patterns on its own.
